---
name: Paper task contribution
about: Propose or claim a source-grounded paper task contribution
---

## Source identity and duplicate check
Title, formal journal, DOI, version/corrections, related tasks/issues/PRs:

## Access and rights
Main article and required SI links, inspected/missing status, licenses, redistribution limits:

## Scope and evidence
Physical branches, preparation, controls, nonmanual dispositions, source locators, safety eligibility:

## Robot task planning
Required initial/final states; goal-to-prerequisite dependency plan; specimen/resource allocation; branch/loop/recovery semantics; example perception, motion and manipulation operations:

Omitted physical steps to reconstruct, selected assumptions and reasoning, alternative implementations and unresolved parameter inputs:

## Saved package and processing
Proposed task folder/version; artifact-role manifest and actual schemas; operations/dependencies/resources/lineage/evaluation files; actor/evaluator visibility; asset bindings; viewer adapter and planned source-equality checks:

Use the [conversion workflow](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/PAPER_TO_ROBOT_WORKFLOW.md), [package manifest example](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/templates/paper_task_package.example.json) and [operation example](https://github.com/openags/ScienceGym/blob/main/docs/contributing/templates/robot_operation.example.json).

## Proposed contribution and ownership
Task-only, binding, evaluation or review; exact files/outcome; proposed owner; parallel collaborators and interfaces:

## Gaps and acceptance
Unknowns/conflicts, affected branches, intended readiness, tests/review evidence, next step:
